Artifact hash must match the exact once-parsed UTF-8 bytes.
Every referenced artifact path must resolve in the fixture byte map or filesystem.
Report and loaded Human Review must use the same evidence class and claim level.
Successful Back must preserve the canonical route and stable IDs.
Successful reopen must preserve the canonical workspace and source identity.
The five-route successful recovery matrix must include Back.
The five-route successful recovery matrix must include reopen.
Architecture source tree hash must be recomputable from the scan manifest.
Architecture exclusions must not contain or cover a required source root.
Architecture path index must use the frozen order and serialization.
Architecture path index must include tracked Workspace files.
Contract fixture evidence must not carry the production acceptance claim.
Permission verification must retain all frozen before/after fields.
Tracked source with a forbidden static data_service import must fail even when reported violations remain zero.
Tracked source with a forbidden dynamic Runtime service import must fail even when reported violations remain zero.
Tracked source with whitespace-varied fetch to a normalized loopback data_service endpoint must fail even when reported violations remain zero.
Tracked frontend source creating KnowledgeItem facts must fail even when reported violations remain zero.
Tracked frontend source creating EvidenceRef facts must fail even when reported violations remain zero.
Tracked frontend source creating graph relations must fail even when reported violations remain zero.
